!:
🛠️ Core / Runtime
!help - show this help
!status - show bot health, active rooms, and ban statistics
!tasks [all|full|failed|stale|restarting|restarted|problems] - show supervised background tasks and watchdog state
!config [all|page|last] / show/search/find/diff/set/unset - show/edit runtime config
!reload / !reloadconfig - reload config.py at runtime
!restart confirm - stop the bot so a supervisor can restart it
!checkupdate / !updatecheck - check if a newer bot release is available
!whoami - show your affiliation/role
!audit [all|page|last|query] - show recent audit events

💾 Backup / Restore
!backup - create a full backup
!backup list [all|page|last] - list full backups
!backup show <filename|latest> - show backup details
!backup verify <filename|latest> - verify a backup
!backup delete/remove/del/rm <filename|latest> - delete a backup
!restore <filename|latest> confirm - restore a full backup

🏠 Rooms / Policy
!room add/remove/delete/del/rm - manage protected rooms
!room/rooms list [joined|offline|problems] [all|page|last] - list protected rooms
!room rejoin <room|all> - retry selected protected-room joins
!room invite list [all|page|last] - list pending room invites
!room invite accept/decline/remove/delete/del/rm <id> - accept or remove a room invite
!room invite cleanup [expired] - cleanup pending or expired room invites
!policy / !rules show/set/clear/delete/remove/enable/disable/help/usage - manage public rules/policy text

🛡️ Moderation
!ban <jid|nick> [comment] - ban or update an existing permanent ban reason
!tempban <jid|nick> <10m|2h|1d> [comment] - add/update tempban; omitted reason is preserved
!unban <jid|nick> - remove ban
!banedit <target> <operation> ... - edit reason, duration or ban type
!redact <jid> [reason] - redact indexed messages from a JID in protected rooms
!redact id <room_jid> <stanza_id> [reason] - redact one known stanza ID
!redact cleanup - cleanup old redaction index entries

🔎 Ban Queries
!banlist / !blacklist [all|page|last] - show all active bans with remaining time and comments
!banlist rtbl / !blacklist rtbl [all|page|last] - show RTBL hash and domain entries
!bansearch <query> [all|page|last] - search bans by nick, domain, jid or RTBL reason
!why <nick|jid> - show the reason and remaining time for a ban
!baninfo <target> - show complete current ban metadata
!history <target> [all|page|last] - show moderation history

✅ Ignorelist / Whitelist
!ignore [list] [all|page|last] - show global ignorelist (alias: !whitelist)
!ignore add <jid|domain> [reason] - protect from all bans
!ignore remove/delete/del/rm <jid|domain> - remove from ignorelist
!whitelist [list|all|page|last|add|remove|delete|del|rm] - alias for !ignore

🔄 Sync
!sync - rejoin rooms, verify admin rights, and enforce all active bans
!syncadmins - update admin list from the admin room
!syncbans - sync bans from all rooms into the database and enforce them

🛡️ Protections
!protections list [all|page|last] - list available protections with enabled/disabled state
!protection enable/disable <name> - enable or disable a protection
!protections <name> show/config - show protection configuration
!protections <name> set <key> <value> - update protection configuration
!protections <name> reset - reset a protection to defaults
!protections <name> observe <on|off> - toggle consequence-free observation
!protections reporters add/remove/list <jid> - manage trusted reporters
!report <nick|jid> [reason] - report abuse as trusted reporter

🔐 OMEMO
!omemo status - show OMEMO state
!omemo devices - show admin-room recipients and storage hints
!omemo reset [confirm] - rotate OMEMO storage after confirmation

🛡️ RTBL
!rtbl list [all|page|last] - show active RTBL subscriptions
!rtbl add <service> <node> - subscribe to a RTBL node
!rtbl delete/remove/del/rm <service> [node] - remove a RTBL subscription
!rtbl refresh [service_jid] [node] - refresh RTBL subscriptions now
!rtbl publish status - status of your own RTBL feed
!rtbl publish sync - publish all current bans to your own feed

📦 Import / Export
!export [list|show|delete|remove|del|rm] [all|page|last] - export/list/show/delete managed CSV ban exports
!import <filename> [dryrun] - import bans from a CSV file
